scripts.dev: cargo build && npm run build:sdk && npm run dev --workspace wangcai-desktop
scripts.build: cargo build && npm run build:sdk && npm run typecheck:app && npm run build --workspace wangcai-desktop
scripts.package: cargo build --release && npm run build:sdk && npm run typecheck:app && npm run package --workspace wangcai-desktop
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @wangcai/sdk && npm run typecheck:app
scripts.typecheck:app: npm run typecheck --workspace wangcai-desktop && npm run typecheck --prefix plugins/terminal && npm run typecheck --prefix plugins/files
